name: software-factory
description: Plugins the software-factory loop installs on a workstation and in a PM workspace. Vendored verbatim from the group's plugin catalog at pinned commits; see deploy/README.md for the pins and the upstream sources.

plugins.name: pm-workspace
plugins.description: Runs a product-management workspace in a plain folder: setup and upgrade, ingest, ticket, readiness-evaluator, task-improver, task-splitter, graduate. Stages every hand-off and tracker change for your review; nothing leaves the workspace without your go-ahead. Graduation into an agent-managed context/spec repo opens the PR and merges it on that go-ahead (adr 0011); code repositories are never auto-merged.

plugins.name: spec-repos
plugins.description: Keeps a team's written specifications in step with the code: retro-generate specs from a codebase, update them per merged commit, check that the repositories the specs cite are checked out.

plugins.name: plg-rules
plugins.description: The group's adopted coding-standard rule packs (review rubric and working conventions) so reviews and generated code follow the same house rules everywhere.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: A pre-tool hook that refuses reads of files that hold passwords and keys (.env files, credentials, cloud logins). A deterrent, not a boundary: it fails open without jq.

plugins.name: team-memory
plugins.description: Moves what the assistant learned in local sessions into the team's shared memory store as a reviewed promote PR.

plugins.name: ux-qa
plugins.description: Clicks through the app in a real browser over the screens a change touched and reports what looked broken, ranked by seriousness.

plugins.name: dev-hygiene
plugins.description: A tidy-up pass before calling code done: verifies the work runs, trims needless complexity without changing behaviour, only proposes.

plugins.name: solo-review
plugins.description: A one-model code review for when the cross-vendor panel is unavailable. Points out issues, never edits. It does not satisfy the cross-vendor axis of the verify gate.
